description: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with managed and bring-your-own-key routing across hundreds of upstream models.
prompt_training_notes: Training and retention depend on the selected upstream route. Kilo flags models whose providers may train on prompts, and Auto Free may route to providers that log prompts and outputs for service improvement.
user_identifier_notes: Kilo Gateway receives account ID and request metadata for authentication, routing, and billing; prompt content is forwarded to the selected upstream provider.
regional_pricing_notes: The public catalogue publishes per-token and optional request, image, web-search, and internal-reasoning rates in USD without region-specific variants.

sources.notes: Unauthenticated live catalogue used to verify exact model IDs, context and output limits, modalities, supported parameters, availability, and pricing.
